jp: 我々は８０７１番目の資源回収部隊だ。別働隊が同じようにこの星にやってくる可能性はゼロではない。私はこの区画で機能休止…廃品に埋もれ眠ることにしたが、もしも別働隊があの遥かなる星の海からやってきたら教えてくれないか。上手くいくかはわからないが、その時は再び説得にあたってみよう。
jp_grezzo: "我々は８０７１番目の資源回収部隊だ。別働隊が同じようにこの星にやってくる可能性はゼロではない。私はこの区画で機能休止…廃品に埋もれ眠ることにしたが、もしも別働隊があの遥かなる星の海からやってきたら教えてくれないか。上手くいくかはわからないが、その時は再び説得にあたってみよう。"
en: We are the 8071st Resource Recovery Division. The chance that another Recovery Division will come to this planet with the same intentions isn't zero. I will put this Division's mission on hold... I will suspend myself with the rest of this waste, but if another Division happens to come here, could you please inform me? I don't know if I'll be able to persuade them, but if the time comes, I will try...
en_grezzo: "We are the 8071st Resource Recovery Division. The chance that another Recovery Division will come to this planet with the same intentions isn't zero. I will put this Division's mission on hold... I will suspend myself with the rest of this waste, but if another Division happens to come here, could you please inform me? I don't know if I'll be able to persuade them, but if the time comes, I will try..."
it: Siamo l'8071esima squadra di recupero risorse. Che un altro reparto arrivi su questo pianeta con le stesse intenzioni non è impossibile. Io in questo settore sospendo le funzioni... ho deciso di dormire sotto i rottami, ma se un altro reparto dovesse arrivare da quel mare di stelle lontano, me lo dici? Non so se servirà, ma allora proverò di nuovo a convincerli.

jp: 君か…また…会ったな。あれから私はアクセス端末に細工して仲間の大半を行動不能にし、その隙に船の動力部と中枢を修復不能なまでに破壊した。無我夢中だったもので、少し…いや、かなりやりすぎてしまった。…まいったな、どうやら私には資源回収より破壊工作のほうが合っていたようだ。
jp_grezzo: "君か…また…会ったな。あれから私はアクセス端末に細工して仲間の大半を行動不能にし、その隙に船の動力部と中枢を修復不能なまでに破壊した。無我夢中だったもので、少し…いや、かなりやりすぎてしまった。…まいったな、どうやら私には資源回収より破壊工作のほうが合っていたようだ。"
en: We... We meet again. Since last time, I've modified most of the access terminals to lock out my companions, and damaged the control center and power systems beyond repair. I go so caught up in it that I... Yes, I think I went too far... I can't stand it. It seems that somehow I'm more suited for destructive work than resource recovery after all.
en_grezzo: "We... We meet again. Since last time, I've modified most of the access terminals to lock out my companions, and damaged the control center and power systems beyond repair. I go so caught up in it that I... Yes, I think I went too far... I can't stand it. It seems that somehow I'm more suited for destructive work than resource recovery after all."
it: Sei tu... ci... incontriamo di nuovo. Da allora ho manomesso i terminali di accesso e messo fuori uso quasi tutti i miei simili; e approfittandone ho distrutto il gruppo motore e il centro della nave, oltre ogni riparazione. Ero fuori di me, e ho esagerato un po'... anzi, parecchio. ...Che figura: pare che il sabotaggio mi riesca meglio del recupero risorse.

jp: もう星には帰れない、そもそも帰る文明が存在しているのかさえわからない。残った仲間たちは相変わらず説得を聞いてくれず、私を処分しようとする。もう疲れた。
jp_grezzo: "もう星には帰れない、そもそも帰る文明が存在しているのかさえわからない。残った仲間たちは相変わらず説得を聞いてくれず、私を処分しようとする。もう疲れた。"
en: I don't know if the planet I came from still exists, but I can no longer return. The few of my companions that remained still refused to listen and tried to dispose of me. I'm so tired...
en_grezzo: "I don't know if the planet I came from still exists, but I can no longer return. The few of my companions that remained still refused to listen and tried to dispose of me. I'm so tired..."
it: Sul mio pianeta non posso più tornare, e non so nemmeno se la civiltà a cui tornare esista ancora. I compagni rimasti non sentono ragioni e vogliono eliminarmi. Non ne posso più.

jp: 突破口を開いてくれたか、感謝する！これはささやかだがお礼だ。この星でどれだけの価値があるかはわからないが…不要でなければ受け取ってほしい。
jp_grezzo: "突破口を開いてくれたか、感謝する！これはささやかだがお礼だ。この星でどれだけの価値があるかはわからないが…不要でなければ受け取ってほしい。"
en: Thank you for clearing a path for me! It's not much, but please take this. I don't know how valuable it will be on this planet, but... I want you to have it.
en_grezzo: "Thank you for clearing a path for me! It's not much, but please take this. I don't know how valuable it will be on this planet, but... I want you to have it."
it: Mi hai aperto la strada, ti ringrazio! Questo è un piccolo ringraziamento. Non so quanto valga su questo pianeta... ma se non ti è inutile, prendilo.

jp: 私はこれから船に乗り込んで始末をつけてくる。仲間たちの妨害があるだろうが、宇宙生物に比べればなんとでもなるレベルだ。そこまで君に頼むわけにはいかない。
jp_grezzo: "私はこれから船に乗り込んで始末をつけてくる。仲間たちの妨害があるだろうが、宇宙生物に比べればなんとでもなるレベルだ。そこまで君に頼むわけにはいかない。"
en: I'll go and take care of shutting down the ship now. My companions may try to interfere, but they're nothing compared to those space creatures. I will handle them myself... I couldn't ask you to do any more.
en_grezzo: "I'll go and take care of shutting down the ship now. My companions may try to interfere, but they're nothing compared to those space creatures. I will handle them myself... I couldn't ask you to do any more."
it: Adesso salgo a bordo e chiudo la faccenda. I miei simili cercheranno di ostacolarmi, ma in confronto alle creature spaziali è roba da poco. Fin lì non posso chiederti di venire.

jp: さらばだ、異星の友人よ。本当に迷惑をかけたな。
jp_grezzo: "さらばだ、異星の友人よ。本当に迷惑をかけたな。"
en: Farewell, my friend. I am truly sorry to have caused you so much trouble.
en_grezzo: "Farewell, my friend. I am truly sorry to have caused you so much trouble."
it: Addio, amicizia di un altro pianeta. Ti ho dato davvero un gran disturbo.

jp: 我々の乗ってきた船はこの塔から南東に存在するが、船のシステムを止めるには中枢へ辿りつかなくてはならない。しかしそのためには、戦闘用に調整された宇宙生物が防衛している区画をどうしても通らなければならないのだ。宇宙生物を排除してもらえれば、後は私がこの全機能を賭して始末をつけてみせよう。
jp_grezzo: "我々の乗ってきた船はこの塔から南東に存在するが、船のシステムを止めるには中枢へ辿りつかなくてはならない。しかしそのためには、戦闘用に調整された宇宙生物が防衛している区画をどうしても通らなければならないのだ。宇宙生物を排除してもらえれば、後は私がこの全機能を賭して始末をつけてみせよう。"
en: Our ship is located to the southeast of this tower. You must reach the control room at the center to shut down the ship's systems. But to reach this area, you must pass through a section guarded by reprogrammed creatures from space. If you can eliminate the creatures, I will come behind you and take care of the rest.
en_grezzo: "Our ship is located to the southeast of this tower. You must reach the control room at the center to shut down the ship's systems. But to reach this area, you must pass through a section guarded by reprogrammed creatures from space. If you can eliminate the creatures, I will come behind you and take care of the rest."
it: La nave su cui siamo arrivati sta a sud-est di questa torre, ma per fermarne i sistemi bisogna raggiungere il centro. E per arrivarci si deve per forza attraversare un settore difeso dalle creature spaziali, riprogrammate per il combattimento. Se me le elimini, al resto penso io, mettendoci tutte le funzioni che ho.

jp: そうそう、正面の入り口は当然封鎖されている。私は廃品から作り上げた爆発物で廃棄処理区画の壁と天井に穴を開けて出てきた。場所を教える、そこを入り口として侵入してくれ。
jp_grezzo: "そうそう、正面の入り口は当然封鎖されている。私は廃品から作り上げた爆発物で廃棄処理区画の壁と天井に穴を開けて出てきた。場所を教える、そこを入り口として侵入してくれ。"
en: Oh, and the entrance is blocked too of course. I used materials I found in the disposal area to create bombs and blast my way out of the ship. Let me tell you where the holes are so that you can enter that way.
en_grezzo: "Oh, and the entrance is blocked too of course. I used materials I found in the disposal area to create bombs and blast my way out of the ship. Let me tell you where the holes are so that you can enter that way."
it: Ah, già: l'ingresso principale è sbarrato, si capisce. L'uscita me la sono aperta io, con degli esplosivi ricavati dai rifiuti: un buco nel muro e nel soffitto del settore di smaltimento. Ti dico dov'è, ed entri da lì.

jp: 星渡の収穫船の入り口について教えてもらった。
jp_grezzo: "星渡の収穫船の入り口について教えてもらった。"
en: You receive information on how to enter the ship.
en_grezzo: "You receive information on how to enter the ship."
it: Adesso sai come si entra nella Nave Messe.

jp: おお…君は私の話を聞いてくれるのか？
jp_grezzo: "おお…君は私の話を聞いてくれるのか？"
en: Ah... Would you listen to my story?
en_grezzo: "Ah... Would you listen to my story?"
it: Oh... vuoi ascoltare quello che ho da dire?

jp: 単刀直入に言おう。この星は狙われている。
jp_grezzo: "単刀直入に言おう。この星は狙われている。"
en: I'll be blunt. This planet is being targeted.
en_grezzo: "I'll be blunt. This planet is being targeted."
it: Vado dritto al punto. Questo pianeta è nel mirino.

jp: 私は資源回収用に造られた機械生命体。メモリーによれば造物主たちに代わって遥かなる星の海を渡り、異星から資源を持ち帰るのが使命なのだが…
jp_grezzo: "私は資源回収用に造られた機械生命体。メモリーによれば造物主たちに代わって遥かなる星の海を渡り、異星から資源を持ち帰るのが使命なのだが…"
en: I am a mechanical lifeform designed for resource extraction. If my data is without error, my creator sent me from a distant planet on a mission to explore and bring back resources from other planets.
en_grezzo: "I am a mechanical lifeform designed for resource extraction. If my data is without error, my creator sent me from a distant planet on a mission to explore and bring back resources from other planets."
it: Sono una forma di vita meccanica costruita per il recupero delle risorse. Stando alla memoria, la missione è attraversare il mare di stelle lontano al posto dei creatori e riportare risorse da altri pianeti, ma...

jp: 私が再起動したとき、万年単位で計測可能な計器が振り切れていた。通信装置も故障はしていないはずなのだが応答が無く、いったいどれだけの年月が過ぎたのか、造物主たちが今存命しているのかさえ不明な状況だ。
jp_grezzo: "私が再起動したとき、万年単位で計測可能な計器が振り切れていた。通信装置も故障はしていないはずなのだが応答が無く、いったいどれだけの年月が過ぎたのか、造物主たちが今存命しているのかさえ不明な状況だ。"
en: However, after my reactivation I noticed that my instruments to measure the passage of time had stopped at 10,000 years. My transmission equipment is without error yet my communications receive no response, The amount of time that has passed - and whether my creator is even still alive - is unknown.
en_grezzo: "However, after my reactivation I noticed that my instruments to measure the passage of time had stopped at 10,000 years. My transmission equipment is without error yet my communications receive no response, The amount of time that has passed - and whether my creator is even still alive - is unknown."
it: Alla riattivazione, lo strumento che misura il tempo, quello che conta a decine di migliaia di anni, era fuori scala. L'apparato di comunicazione non dovrebbe essere guasto, eppure non risponde nessuno: quanti anni siano passati, e se i creatori siano ancora in vita, non lo so.

jp: 知的生命体の暮らす星だった場合は友好関係のためにもまず造物主たちの判断をあおぐことになっている。だが私の仲間たちは独断で宇宙生物を用いてこの星を制圧し様々な資源を持ち帰ろうと暗躍しているのだ。私も説得を試みたのだが、思考プログラムの欠陥と判断され廃棄処理区画に送られてしまった。
jp_grezzo: "知的生命体の暮らす星だった場合は友好関係のためにもまず造物主たちの判断をあおぐことになっている。だが私の仲間たちは独断で宇宙生物を用いてこの星を制圧し様々な資源を持ち帰ろうと暗躍しているのだ。私も説得を試みたのだが、思考プログラムの欠陥と判断され廃棄処理区画に送られてしまった。"
en: My creator's programming indicated that we should establish peaceful relations with any planet containing intelligent life. However, my companions are acting on their own and plan to use creatures from space to gain control of this planet. I tried to persuade them, but they deemed my thought processes defective and sent me for disposal.
en_grezzo: "My creator's programming indicated that we should establish peaceful relations with any planet containing intelligent life. However, my companions are acting on their own and plan to use creatures from space to gain control of this planet. I tried to persuade them, but they deemed my thought processes defective and sent me for disposal."
it: Se il pianeta ha vita intelligente, la regola è chiedere prima il giudizio dei creatori, per stabilire rapporti amichevoli. Ma i miei compagni hanno deciso da soli: vogliono usare le creature spaziali per soggiogare questo pianeta e portarsi via ogni risorsa. Ho provato a farli ragionare, e mi hanno giudicato un difetto del programma di pensiero e spedito allo smaltimento.

jp: この星の人々に頼むのも非常に筋違いな話だが、どうか仲間たちの暴挙を止めるのに協力してほしいのだ…。
jp_grezzo: "この星の人々に頼むのも非常に筋違いな話だが、どうか仲間たちの暴挙を止めるのに協力してほしいのだ…。"
en: I know it to be unreasonable to ask this of the people of this planet, but I would like to cooperate with me to stop their plans...
en_grezzo: "I know it to be unreasonable to ask this of the people of this planet, but I would like to cooperate with me to stop their plans..."
it: So che chiederlo alla gente di questo pianeta è del tutto fuori luogo, ma vorrei un aiuto per fermare quello che stanno facendo...

jp: 都合が悪くなければ、また話しかけてほしい。詳細を話そう。
jp_grezzo: "都合が悪くなければ、また話しかけてほしい。詳細を話そう。"
en: If you agree, then please speak with me again. I will fill you in on the details.
en_grezzo: "If you agree, then please speak with me again. I will fill you in on the details."
it: Se non ti scombina i piani, torna a parlarmi: ti spiego i dettagli.

jp: 君も彼らと同類なのか…。
en: So you're the same as the others then...
en_grezzo: "So you're the same as the others then..."
it: Allora sei anche tu come loro...
